proofs.text: Write a spec whose `## Proof` section is empty and call the payload builder; verify RULE-1 reads the spec status `drafted` and an empty proof list

rule_text: A rule that no proof line names has the spec status `drafted` and an empty proof list

tests.body:
def test_drafted_when_there_is_no_proof(self, project):
        project.spec('# Feature: login

## Rules

- RULE-1: It works

'
                     '## Proof
')
        rule = project.rule('RULE-1')
        assert rule['spec'] == 'drafted'
        assert rule['proofs'] == []
